회사 소개
쿠팡이츠(Coupang Eats)는 음식배달을 시작으로 장보기와 쇼핑까지 서비스 영역을 확장하며 고객의 일상을 더욱 편리하게 만드는 새로운 경험을 만들어가고 있습니다. 고객에게 더 나은 경험을 제공하기 위한 끊임없는 고민을 바탕으로 도전하며, 새로운 서비스와 카테고리의 변화를 이끌고 있습니다.
쿠팡이츠는 스스로 기회를 만들고 결과를 만들어낸 구성원에게 더 큰 역할과 책임을 부여하고 있습니다. 자신의 아이디어를 실행으로 옮기고, 성과를 통해 더 큰 기회를 만들어가며, 비즈니스의 성장을 직접 이끄는 성취감을 경험할 수 있습니다.
분야별 전문가들과 더 큰 도전을 통해 함께 성장하고 싶다면, 지금 쿠팡이츠와 함께하세요.
직무 소개

Level Up Your Career with Zynga!
At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.
From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!
Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.
Join us and be part of the play!
Position Overview
Zynga, the global leader in mobile games, is currently seeking a full-time
Associate Manager, Business Operations
. We are looking for a highly organized, self-motivated operator who excels at cross-functional communication, process management, and relationship building.
In this role, you will act as a central pillar for Zynga’s Global Operations team. You will drive operational compliance, own end-to-end workflows for key cross functional projects, including our Global Fonts Program, and coordinate Player Data Compliance vendor proposals. This position bridges the gap between our global game studios and centralized corporate teams (Publishing, Privacy, Compliance, Legal, and Engineering).
Our ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who thrives on bringing people together, translating complex compliance requirements into actionable steps, and driving operational initiatives to the finish line.
What You'll Do
End-to-End Program Ownership:
Lead the operational execution of key global workflows, initially anchoring the Global Fonts Program and the Player Data Compliance strategy across all Zynga games, acting as the primary central point of contact.
Cross-Functional Alignment:
Act as the central bridge between creative game studios and corporate teams (Publishing, Legal, Privacy, Procurement, and Engineering) to review commercial terms, manage vendor proposal workflows, and ensure alignment on corporate standards.
Risk Mitigation & Data Integrity:
Maintain critical tracking ecosystems (databases, software clearances, usage records, and active contracts) and drive proactive compliance initiatives, such as identifying and deprecating high-risk assets across the global portfolio.
Process Optimization & Innovation:
Continuously evolve operational pipelines to drive efficiency; leverage modern tools (including generative AI like Gemini) to streamline workflows, and partner with technical teams to test and sign off on innovative creative pipelines.
Program/Project Management Support:
Provide project management support for ad-hoc studio operations initiatives, including software migrations, tool rollouts, and M&A integration support.
What You Bring
Operational Experience:
2+ years of project management, program coordination, or business operations experience—preferably within software development, gaming, or compliance-heavy environments.
Relationship Builder:
Demonstrated ability to earn trust, empower teams, and build strong, collaborative relationships across diverse cultures, disciplines, and work styles.
Exceptional Communicator:
Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to synthesize complex legal or technical requirements into clear, data-driven updates.
Process-Oriented:
Experience managing high-volume intake workflows, meticulously tracking approvals, and maintaining flawless documentation.
Autonomous Operator:
Proven ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and drive results with minimal supervision.
Technical Proficiency:
Hands-on experience with Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Slides), Airtable, and Atlassian tools (Jira/Confluence).
Bonus Points:
Familiarity with generative AI tools (like Gemini) to optimize daily operations and workflows.
This is a perfect opportunity for an organized, self-motivated operator who wants to play a tangible, visible role in Zynga’s continued success. If you are ready to own critical processes and build the systems that help our global studios scale, we’d love to have you on the team.
What We Offer You

Subject to those same considerations, the total compensation package for this position may also include other elements, including a bonus and/or equity awards and eligibility to participate in our 401(K) plan and Employee Stock Purchase Program.
Regular, full-time employees are also eligible for a range of benefits at the Company, including: medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance coverage; 14 paid holidays per calendar year; paid vacation time per calendar year (ranging from 15 to 25 days) or eligibility to participate in the Company’s discretionary time off program; up to 10 paid sick days per calendar year; paid parental and compassionate leave; wellbeing programs for mental health and other wellness support; family planning support through Maven; commuter benefits; and reimbursements for fitness-related expenses. Our people at JLL are shaping the future of real estate for a better world by combining world class services, advisory and technology for our clients. Whether you’ve got deep experience in commercial real estate, skilled trades or technology, or you’re looking to apply your relevant experience to a new industry, join our team as we help shape a brighter way forward.

MAINTENANCE TECHNICIAN

Maintenance Technician – Site Minor Works

Position Summary

The Maintenance Technician supports the installation and relocation of laboratory instrumentation and equipment. The role provides hands-on execution for laboratory and facility Site Minor Works, including equipment moves, decommissioning, and asset tracking, while coordinating contractors, vendors, and site support teams. The position maintains equipment and asset records, supports compliance and safety requirements, and keeps stakeholders informed from project intake through closeout.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

· Escort, hand-move, unpack, install, and remove laboratory and facility equipment.

· Assess site preparation requirements and connect utilities, including electrical, gas, water, and data, for new and relocated instrumentation.

· Coordinate relocation logistics and perform pre-move documentation and decontamination procedures for laboratory equipment moves.

· Safely disconnect, transport, and reinstall sensitive instrumentation, and confirm equipment function after each move.

· Evaluate equipment condition for disposal decisions and execute decontamination and decommissioning procedures in compliance with environmental and safety regulations.

· Coordinate equipment disposal or surplus through the appropriate channel, including recycling, hazardous waste, and remarketing.

· Tag, photograph, document, and gather all required data for laboratory equipment, and remove retired instruments from asset management systems.

· Track equipment performance metrics, monitor service histories, and maintain comprehensive asset records using computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS).

· Provide technical input for replacement planning and capital budgeting based on equipment condition and performance data.

· Diagnose equipment malfunctions and coordinate with external service vendors when specialized support is needed.

· Support and coordinate with contractors on activities impacting lab space, and communicate operational updates to stakeholders.

· Maintain installation records, move logs, retirement certificates, maintenance histories, manuals, and asset tracking information.

· Maintain safe handling practices throughout all equipment installation, move, and retirement activities.

Scope of Support

· Laboratory and facility equipment installations, relocations, upgrades, modifications, and retirements.

· Utility connections supporting laboratory and facility equipment, including electrical, gas, water, and data.

· Contractor coordination, site access planning, and required escorts.

· Equipment decommissioning, disposal, and surplus coordination, including recycling, hazardous waste, and remarketing channels.

· Asset data coordination needed to preserve record integrity and CMMS compliance.

· Move documentation, decontamination procedures, and post-move confirmation.

Minimum Qualifications

· Associate degree or technical certification in biomedical equipment technology, electronics, mechanical systems, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

· Hands-on experience installing, moving, and maintaining laboratory instrumentation.

· Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.

· Familiarity with rigging and equipment transport procedures.

· Knowledge of calibration standards and validation protocols.

· Understanding of laboratory safety and decontamination procedures.

· Working knowledge of asset management systems and CMMS records.

Preferred Qualifications

· Experience in life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, research, or other regulated facilities.

· Knowledge of GMP, EHS, and quality expectations applicable to assigned work.

· Certified Maintenance Technician, CMRT, or other relevant technical or reliability credential.

· Experience supporting laboratory equipment lifecycle activities and multi-trade utility installations.

· Familiarity with asset management and CMMS/EAMS data governance.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

· Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills across a range of laboratory equipment types.

· Clear written and verbal communication with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

· Ability to follow calibration standards, validation protocols, and laboratory safety and decontamination procedures.

· Customer-focused problem solving and professional vendor and contractor coordination.

· Ability to manage multiple concurrent activities while maintaining attention to safety, quality, and compliance.

· Sound judgment, proactive escalation, and disciplined record keeping.

· Ability to work collaboratively across matrixed account and client teams.

Performance Expectations

· Equipment installations, moves, and retirements are completed safely, on schedule, and with clear documentation.

· Asset records, CMMS data, and turnover deliverables are accurate, current, and audit-ready.

· Contractor and vendor activities are coordinated safely and in alignment with approved scope and site requirements.

· Stakeholders receive timely, accurate operational and status updates.

· Safety and decontamination procedures are followed on every project, with issues escalated promptly.

Work Environment and Physical Requirements

The position operates in office, laboratory, mechanical, and active project environments. Site access requirements may include walking project areas, using required personal protective equipment, entering controlled spaces, and observing contractor activities. Specific physical, schedule, travel, and work authorization requirements should be confirmed for the final posting and aligned with JLL and client policies.

· Have the ability to lift and move equipment, typically up to 50 lbs, with assistance for heavier items.

This position does not provide visa sponsorship. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship.

78,000.00 – 88,000.00 USD per year

Final compensation packages are determined by various considerations including but not limited to candidate qualifications, location, market conditions, and internal considerations.

Personalized benefits that support personal well-being and growth:

JLL recognizes the impact that the workplace can have on your wellness, so we offer a supportive culture and comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes mental, physical and emotional health. Some of these benefits include:

ABOUT APPLY

APPLY is the Agentic Customer Experience (ACx) partner for the world's most ambitious consumer and entertainment brands. We bring together deep domain expertise across Retail, CPG, Sports, and Media with AI-native delivery capability, designing and delivering agentic solutions that turn CX vision into commercial reality. We are the partner of choice for brands like Arc'teryx, NFL, Lululemon, and Kraft Heinz. For more information, visit applydigital.com.

LOCATION: APPLY is hybrid/remote friendly. The preferred candidate should be based in Canada, working in hours that align to ET (Eastern Timezone) or PT (Pacific Timezone).

THE ROLE:

As an Agentic Product Design Lead, you will be a hands-on senior design leader at the intersection of craft, systems thinking, and AI-native workflows. Reporting to the Head of Design, you will lead complex client engagements end-to-end — owning design quality across multi-product and multi-platform projects while actively designing alongside AI agents as a core part of how you work.
This is a role for a practitioner who leads by doing. You bring deep expertise in design systems — from token architecture and component governance to CMS integration and developer handoff — and you know how to operationalize that expertise within modern agentic workflows using tools like Claude for Design, Figma MCP, and BMAD. You are equally comfortable presenting design rationale to senior client stakeholders and rolling up your sleeves to build the systems and screens yourself.
You will mentor and guide designers at various levels, champion design system standards across your engagements, and contribute to evolving how Apply Digital designs and delivers in an AI-accelerated world.

Design Leadership & Quality:

• Set and uphold the bar for UI design quality across all client engagements, ensuring deliverables reflect APPLY's standards and each client's brand vision from foundational token architecture and atomic component libraries through to polished, production-ready screen design.
• Lead and actively contribute to the creation of high-quality screen designs, prototypes, and design systems across multi-product and multi-platform projects, with deep hands-on expertise in foundations, tokens, and atomic design methodology.
• Define and govern design system standards including token naming conventions, tier structures (global, alias, component), theming strategies, and component documentation ensuring systems are scalable, maintainable, and developer-ready.
• Establish and champion design frameworks, UX principles, and visual consistency practices across the team, embedding design system thinking at every stage of the project lifecycle.
• Drive design critique culture and create structured feedback loops that elevate the work, with a sharp eye for system integrity, component reuse, and cross-platform consistency.
• Champion the integration of agentic design workflows and AI-powered tooling including Claude for design to accelerate design system production, automate token management, and unlock new levels of craft and efficiency across the team.

Client & Stakeholder Partnership:

• Act as a senior design voice in client relationships, presenting concepts, rationale, and recommendations with confidence and clarity.
• Lead discovery, alignment, and design review sessions with senior client stakeholders.
• Build trusted relationships with clients, earning confidence as a strategic partner not just a delivery lead.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with product, engineering, strategy, and delivery teams to ensure design is integrated throughout the project lifecycle.

Practice & Strategic Growth:

• Define and evolve APPLY's UI and experience design practice, including tooling, process, and standards.
• Contribute to business development efforts by supporting proposals, pitches, and capability demonstrations.
• Represent APPLY's design perspective externally through thought leadership, community engagement, and industry participation.
• Stay ahead of design trends, emerging tools, and shifts in the Canadian and global digital landscape.

Must Haves:

• 8+ years of experience in UI/UX design, with at least 3 years in a leadership role.
• Experience working in Claude Design and any Agentic Workflow, e.g. BMAD.
• Proven track record leading UI Design and a team of UI designers on large Client Engagements.
• Strong portfolio demonstrating leadership across complex, multi-product, and multi-platform design engagements; Headless CMS Design Experience explicitly highlighted in the portfolio is preferred.
• Expert proficiency in Figma, Figma Make and Claude Design as well as industry-standard design tools; deep knowledge of design systems creation, governance, and implementation.
• Demonstrated ability to build and sustain senior client relationships, with experience presenting to executive stakeholders.
• Excellent communication, facilitation, and storytelling skills.
• Experience working in cross-functional environments alongside product managers, engineers, and strategists.
• Comfort with ambiguity, competing priorities, and the pace of a growing consultancy.
• Eligibility to work in Canada; based in or willing to work in Canadian time zones.

Nice to Haves:

• Experience working with Canadian public sector, financial services, retail, or healthcare clients.
• Familiarity with accessibility standards including WCAG 2.1/2.2 and AODA compliance.
• Background in graphic design, product design or brand design.
• Knowledge of front-end technologies and how design decisions affect implementation.
• Active participation in Canadian design communities, conferences, or industry networks.
• Bilingual (English/French) is an asset.

ABOUT MISTRAL

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

THE ROLE

As a Product Manager on the Vibe team, you will define and execute the strategy for Mistral Vibe Code and Mistral Vibe Work—Mistral AI’s flagship interfaces for AI-driven productivity.

Mistral Vibe Code is a coding assistant designed for developers and engineering teams. It helps users write, understand, refactor, and ship code through developer-native interfaces like the CLI, IDE, and web. It leverages Mistral’s advanced models, integrates repository context, and uses tooling and agentic workflows to automate and enhance the development process.

Mistral Vibe Work is an agentic productivity environment tailored for enterprise knowledge work. It enables business users to complete complex, multi-step tasks—such as research, reporting, and automations—across company knowledge, tools, and workflows. AI agents, fluent in enterprise context, drive these processes, making it easier for teams to collaborate and execute high-value work.

In this role, you’ll shape the next generation of AI-driven productivity tools, moving beyond traditional conversational AI to redefine how professionals—from developers to enterprise users—interact with information and create content. You’ll empower millions of users by building experiences that combine Mistral’s cutting-edge models with contextual understanding, tool integration, and intelligent automation.

This role demands a blend of strategic vision, technical depth, business acumen, and user obsession. You’ll work closely with engineering, design, and go-to-market teams to deliver intuitive, high-impact solutions that align with company goals and capitalize on market opportunities. Your mission is to bridge the gap between AI innovation and real-world productivity, ensuring that Mistral’s tools are not just powerful but also practical and user-centric.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Set the vision by shaping and evangelizing a product strategy for Mistral Vibe Code and Mistral Vibe Work, ensuring alignment with company goals and market opportunities.

- Lead market and UX research to uncover unmet needs, competitive gaps, and emerging trends in AI-driven productivity for developers and enterprise users.

- Drive end-to-end product development, from ideation to launch and iteration, balancing speed, quality, and user delight.

- Partner with design and research to craft intuitive, high-impact experiences for developer-native interfaces (CLI, IDE, web) and enterprise workflows.

- Collaborate with marketing and sales to develop pricing, positioning, and adoption strategies for successful product launches.

- Align engineering, design, and business teams around priorities, trade-offs, and timelines.

About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

We are hiring Support Engineers to serve as the named, dedicated Product Support point of contact for Anthropic's most strategic enterprise customers. As a Support Engineer, you'll be providing high-touch, deeply contextual support to a defined book of accounts — embedded in your customers' shared channels, known by name to their stakeholders, and partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Applied AI as the technical support voice on the account team.

You'll bring deep knowledge of how each of your customers is built on Claude to every interaction, so you can investigate, diagnose, and resolve their most complex technical needs with nuance and speed — and ensure the right internal teams are engaged when needed.

Responsibilities

• Serve as the named technical support contact for a defined book of strategic enterprise accounts, embedded in customer channels and joining recurring account cadences as the support voice
• Own your customers' technical support needs end to end — investigate, diagnose, and resolve complex issues directly, and partner with internal Engineering and Product teams to drive resolution when needed
• Build deep, durable context on each customer's architecture, integrations, and use cases so you can respond with nuance rather than from a script
• Partner closely with the Customer Success Manager, Account Executive, and Applied AI team on each account as part of a single, coordinated account team
• Capture technical feedback and product friction from your accounts and route it to Product with the impact data and detail needed to prioritize it correctly
• Manage high-urgency issues for your accounts with extreme ownership, and coordinate cleanly with the broader Product Support team for continuous coverage
• Help build the foundations of the Support Engineer function — runbooks, escalation paths, tooling, and the metrics we'll use to measure its value
• Become an expert in all Anthropic products across the API, Claude for Enterprise, and Claude Code

You may be a good fit if you

• Have 5+ years in technical product support, with meaningful time in an escalated, priority, or named-account support team for enterprise customers
• Have been the person an enterprise customer knows by name and reaches for first when they need technical help
• Are deeply fluent with APIs and technical SaaS products, and can read technical documentation, error logs, and request traces with ease
• Have hands-on experience troubleshooting SSO, SAML, OAuth, and enterprise authentication flows
• Are persistent and curious — you delight in the hunt of tracking down a bug, and are energized by fixing it for every similar user going forward
• Possess strong user empathy and crisp, kind written communication; you can translate between a frustrated customer engineer and an internal platform team without losing either
• Are comfortable operating in ambiguity, making informed decisions in never-before-seen situations, and knowing when to pull the escalation cord
• Enjoy building trust and collaborating closely with go-to-market partners (Sales, CS, Applied AI) without owning the commercial relationship yourself
• Have contributed to the foundations of a support team before — the essential, often unglamorous work of writing the first runbook
